modelDescription: Lightweight, accurate and reliable, the Mossberg Patriot is a great choice for someone who wants a quality hunting rifle without having to pay a premium price. Standard Patriot features include drop box magazines, recessed crowns, fluted barrels, spiral fluted bolt streamlined bolt handle, Weaver scope bases, patented Lightning Bolt Action LBA® user-adjustable trigger system. Youth Patriot models with variable length of pull and 20 barrels are also available. Just mount your scope, sight it in, and this game taker is ready to go to work.
